newsitem.title: USA: DCI Telecom to merge with Cardcall.
newsitem.headline: DCI Telecom to merge with Cardcall.

text.p: DCI Telecommunications Inc said Wednesday it had signed a definitive agreement to merge with Cardcall International Holdings Inc in a stock and cash deal worth more than $1 million.
DCI said it will exchange one share of its common stock for each share of Cardcall and pay an additional $1 million in consideration.
A company official, who expected the deal to close within a week, said Cardcall had between seven and eight million shares.
He said the deal was worth about $40 million.
DCI said the new company will use its name, DCI Telecommunications.
Cardcall, which makes pre-paid phone cards, has subsidiaries in Canada and the United Kingdom with combined sales totaling about $15 million.
Based in Fairfield, Connecticut, DCI makes telecommunications software for computers, among other things.
